questions.question: What are the two main things you should compare between texts?

points.text: Perspectives (viewpoints) and methods (how they convey those viewpoints).

questions.question: What is the difference between an integrated approach and writing about texts separately?

points.text: Integrated approach compares within each paragraph using connectives; separate approach writes about each text individually without comparing.

questions.question: Name three comparative connectives for showing differences.

points.text: However, in contrast, whereas, on the other hand, unlike.

questions.question: Why should you use evidence from both texts?

points.text: To show you can analyse both texts and make valid comparisons - it proves your comparison is based on evidence.
